blocks.text: Burnaby Lake homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Burnaby Lake, September 2026. Detached houses: 19 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 3 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 33%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 6 sold over 4 months against an average of 21.0 listed, about 14.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 2 sold. Condos and townhomes: 4 sold over 4 months against an average of 4.2 listed, about 4.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 2 sold.

faq.q: Is Burnaby Lake a neighbourhood or a park?
faq.a: Both names are in use for different things: Burnaby Lake Regional Park is a 360-acre Metro Vancouver regional park around the lake, managed by Metro Vancouver since 1978 under a 25-year lease agreement with the City, and "Burnaby Lake" is also the GVR MLS® sub-area name for the housing on the streets around it.

faq.q: What can you do at Burnaby Lake?
faq.a: Metro Vancouver describes a wildlife sanctuary with walking trails, viewing towers and docks, a Nature House, and a rowing course with a pavilion and public canoe launch at the Burnaby Lake Sports Complex; the complex itself has 5 lit artificial turf fields and 17 tennis courts in the City's listings.

faq.q: How is transit at Burnaby Lake?
faq.a: Sperling–Burnaby Lake Station (Millennium Line) sits at Sperling Avenue and Lougheed Highway at the area's north-west side, you can walk into the park directly from the station, and buses 110, 134 and 144 connect there — the 144 links the station to Metrotown and SFU.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Burnaby Lake address?
faq.a: It depends on which edge of the lake the address is on. Nearby SD41 schools include Sperling Elementary (K–7), 2200 Sperling Ave, École Seaforth Elementary (K–7), 7881 Government Rd, and Burnaby Central Secondary (8–12), 6011 Deer Lake Parkway; catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: What is being built at Burnaby Lake?
faq.a: A new Burnaby Lake Recreation Centre beside the existing Bill Copeland Sports Centre — one of the City's four major facilities past the halfway mark in its capital program — plus a delivered pedestrian and cycling overpass across Highway 1 at the lake.
